purpose: Compare K-OVERLAY-PIDNS-001 with K-PIDNS-001 under the unchanged minimal-v6 excluded-initialize control plane, fixed Toybox probe, and independent stock recovery contract.

classification.basis: The external kernel exchanged capabilities and configuration, dynamically associated the registered Toybox VHDX, and received LaunchInit. Overlay support removed the prior absent-overlay SIGSEGV signature, but WslCorePort closed before CreateInstanceResult.

candidateInterval.failureSignature: Overlay removed the prior SIGSEGV, then WslCorePort closed after LaunchInit without CreateInstanceResult or captured guest logs

traceAnalysis.directEvidence: Registered-distro association completed and LaunchInit was sent; the prior absent-overlay crash disappeared, but the guest channel closed before CreateInstanceResult and ETW captured no guest log records.

comparison.overlayPidResult: B3 with guest channel closure and no SIGSEGV dump
comparison.decision: Overlay changes the post-LaunchInit failure signature but does not establish B4 or select any unrelated kernel group.

decision: Finalize this combination at B3 without an unchanged rerun. Preserve overlay as unresolved within the reduced-kernel path. Because ETW captured no guest logs and selects no further Kconfig facility, prepare one bounded diagnostic sibling with transactional debugConsole capture before choosing another kernel or control-plane change.
